implementation_revision: Containing source commit; exact blobs below
cause: Source roads prepare before input. Normal V creates a LIVE body during movement, tags its source route, then moves it before the next source-road preparation. The independent body cache was absent.
correction: At the voluntary LIVE-body creation transition, clone the already prepared per-actor route configuration into that body cache before same-tick horizontal recovery. No generic base-context fallback.
regressions: ordinary_dismount_prepares_body_context_before_same_tick_source_motion: full and selected movement, source route configuration distinct from base
ordinary_dismount_body_context_is_released_and_rebuilt_on_the_next_episode: two complete schema6 dismount/get-up/walk/remount episodes with cache cleanup/rebuild
baseline_failures: Both tests reproduce the actual missing-key panic before the correction. Initial invalid fixture/schema attempts and an unrealistic terrain-height discontinuity are retained privately and excluded from accepted results.
after: Both corrected targeted tests pass; native source-course construction uses height0 and grade in topology, so fixture distinction uses authentic road-width context rather than an artificial height jump.
release_status: RC5 remains blocked. Local fixed binary now passes CITYL1 and confirmed CITYL5 repeated voluntary recovery with normal exit; replacement immutable RC6 verification remains required. G5 not signed.
